I’m proud to have the support of @brandon_4948 and Toronto Public Library workers from across Toronto. 

Together, we can win better library service and make sure that all public libraries are open 7 days a week.

Today, I announced my plan to expand library hours and make sure every branch is open seven days a week.

Our public libraries are beloved places.

They are where we meet and learn. They provide programs for people of all ages, whether you’re a senior with a book club, a student who needs some quiet space to read, or a new parent with a toddler who wants to hear stories.

Right now, only 19 Toronto Public Library branches are open year-round on Sundays and 30 are closed on Mondays.

My plan will ensure all 100 public libraries are open seven days a week, and have expanded weekday hours of libraries across the city.

I’m thrilled to have been joined by @brandon_4948 & @local4948 and to have their support.

Our libraries couldn’t exist without the library workers who help us find the information we’re looking for, run programs, and make our libraries the community hubs we know and love.

This video is a love letter to my late mother, Ho Sze.

It’s an excerpt from a longer film I made with @minsooklee and Lokchi Lam to honour her.

My mother was a survivor, with an innate sense of justice.

She persisted through the Japanese invasion, domestic violence, immigrating to Canada, and so much more. She came into her political identity based on life experience.

She personified strength, and community care.
No one left our home without a meal.

If there’s one lesson that she taught me and Jack, it was that we’re here on earth to make sure those who don’t have enough, can survive.

What a wonderful day to celebrate women who mother, who care, and persist.

Happy Mother’s Day!

There are thousands of people without a roof over their heads in our city, and even more are just a few paycheques away from losing their home.

I will create 1,000 new rent supplements to help people secure permanent housing, and ask the provincial and federal gov'ts to match our investment to create 2,000 more.

I will create new 24/7 respite spaces, where people can access a shower, meals, a bed, and critical services.

I will create a fund to provide things like wrap-around support services, drop-in programming, and additional shelter options. I’ll let the community lead by working with community agencies, front-line workers and people with lived experience to determine how best to use it.

By introducing a luxury homes tax on homes sold for over $3M we’ll raise millions for those who need it most. 

We’ll be able to provide housing and support for thousands of people. Homelessness is an emergency and we need this funding in place today.

The City’s approach of pushing unhoused people around from parks to transit, to libraries, and back has been shameful. Unhoused people deserve dignity.

We can create a more affordable, safe, and caring Toronto.

Fairness is at the heart of this.

We are in this together.
